title: River Tubing & Kayaking
blurb:
Spend the afternoon floating along the beautiful Waccamaw River on an inflatable river tube or kayak. Bring some food and drinks (or grab some from our Snack Shack) to take with you on your trip to explore the river.

The duration of the trip can vary between 25 - 45 minutes depending on the flow of the river. You can do 2 - 3 trips during the 3 hour reservation window.

When you arrive at our Outpost you will find:
- Fun and games: enjoy our unique super sized yard games: Jenga, Connect 4, Corn Hole and more. 
- Amenities: 4 restrooms, 4 changing rooms with hot showers, hammocks, swings, large fire pit, picnic tables and propane grills that are available for you to use.

If you are looking for more adventure you might like our most popular activity: Escape River Island where you play SURVIVOR games on our private island!
